Identifier type for this ID.
Values are defined in TYPE_CODE of HZ_NAME_AND_ID_TYPE_B.
The party type should be consistent with the party type that the PARTY_IDENTIFIER_TYPE can be applied to. Making the attribute to nullable.

Used for certain types of identifiers such as Passports or Driving licenses.

columns.name: ISSUE_DATE
columns.description:

columns.name: EXPIRATION_DATE
